title: 第1章 哀其不幸怒其不争第2章 我把命还给他
lines: “宁宸，给我滚出来。”
“二公子，你不能进去...四公子感染了风寒，可别传染了你。”
“滚开，该死的狗奴才，敢拦我的路？让那野种别装死，赶紧滚出来见我。”
辱骂声中夹杂着一声响亮的耳光声。
宁宸被惊醒了。
他一脸茫然地打量着这个狭小的房间。
方桌，圆凳，一张破旧的小床，别无他物。
这是哪儿？
宁宸正在疑惑，记忆的碎片强行涌入他的脑海，剧烈的疼痛差点让他晕厥过去。
但这股痛感来得快，去得也快。
宁宸擦了擦额头的冷汗，表情有些古怪...他竟然穿越了。
他原本是地球上某特种部队的指挥官，在跟敌人交火的时候，被流弹击中了要害，为国捐躯了。
死后，竟然穿越到了这个跟他同名同姓的人身上？
这里是大玄皇朝。
这是在历史中从未出现过的朝代。
不过，这具身体的前主人，过得有些惨啊。
父亲宁自明，当朝礼部尚书，正二品。
可宁宸在这个家里，却是过得连下人都不如。
当年，宁自明进京赶考，答应宁宸的母亲，等他考取功名，一定回来接她。
可这一等就是五年。
其实宁自明五年前就高中榜眼，得当朝左相看中，迎娶了左相之女，孩子都三个了。
大玄皇朝以孝为先，宁自明这次回来，只是为了祭祖。
宁宸的母亲根本不知道这一切，还以为宁自明回来是接她去京城享福的。
可一夜欢好后，这个畜生丢下一封休书便离开了！
之后，宁宸的母亲发现自己怀了身孕。
宁宸七岁的时候，母亲抑郁成疾，撒手人寰。
后来，宁宸以乞讨为生，吃百家饭长大。
在宁宸十二岁的时候，宁自明派人找到他，将他接回了宁家。
后来宁宸才知道，并不是宁自明良心发现，而是担心自己的前途。
宁自明得到消息，政敌已经知道他抛妻弃子的事，所以先一步将宁宸接回家，并且编了一个完美的故事。
可宁家主母常如月，以及她的三个儿子，担心宁宸以后分家产，根本不待见宁宸。
宁宸每天小心翼翼地讨好他们，可得到的只有变本加厉的欺辱。
但不管怎么欺辱，宁宸都不吭声，因为他不想再去流浪乞讨了。
可他不知道的是，不管他怎么委曲求全...对方都不会把他当成一家人，而且想要他的命。
如今已经入秋，宁宸还穿着单薄的衣裳，结果感染了风寒。
他们非但不让郎中给宁宸看病，还悄悄往宁宸的被褥上浇凉水。
结果导致宁宸重病无医，一命呜呼。
宁宸叹口气，对于这具身体的前主人，他只有八个字...哀其不幸，怒其不争！
正在这时，门开了。
一个身穿粗布短打的跛脚老人走了进来。
看到坐在床上的宁宸，老人先是一怔，旋即满脸惊喜，道：“四公子，你醒了？太好了，太好了...”
这位跛脚老人，来宁府很久了，宁宸来的时候他就在...其他人叫他老柴，宁宸唤他柴叔。
content_en:
"Ning Chen, get out of here."
"Second Young Master, you can't go in... Fourth Young Master is infected with the cold, please don't infect you."
"Get out of here, you damn dog slave. How dare you block my way? Tell that bastard to stop pretending to be dead and come out to see me."
The insults were punctuated by a loud slap.
Ning Chen was awakened.
He looked around the small room with a blank look on his face.
A square table, a round stool, a shabby little bed, and nothing else.
Where is this?
Ning Chen was wondering when fragments of memory forced into his mind, and the severe pain almost made him faint.
But the pain came and went away just as quickly.
Ning Chen wiped the cold sweat from his forehead with a strange expression... He actually traveled through time.
He was originally the commander of a special forces unit on Earth. During a firefight with the enemy, he was hit in the vital part by a stray bullet and died for his country.
After his death, he actually time-traveled into the body of this person with the same name and surname as him?
This is the Daxuan Dynasty.
This is a dynasty that has never appeared in history.
However, the previous owner of this body had a somewhat miserable life.
My father, Ning Ziming, was the Minister of the Ministry of Rites and was the second rank.
But Ning Chen's life in this family was worse than that of the servants.
Back then, Ning Ziming went to Beijing to take the exam and promised Ning Chen's mother that he would come back to pick her up when he got the honor.
But this wait lasted five years.
In fact, Ning Ziming was ranked second in high school five years ago. He was attracted by the left prime minister and married the daughter of the left prime minister. He has three children.
The Daxuan Dynasty put filial piety first, and Ning Ziming came back this time just to worship his ancestors.
Ning Chen's mother didn't know all this at all, and thought that Ning Ziming came back to take her to the capital to enjoy happiness.
But after a night of fun, this beast dropped a letter of divorce and left!
Later, Ning Chen's mother found out that she was pregnant.
When Ning Chen was seven years old, his mother became depressed and became ill and passed away.
Later, Ning Chen made a living by begging and grew up eating food from hundreds of families.
When Ning Chen was twelve years old, Ning Ziming sent someone to find him and took him back to the Ning family.
Later, Ning Chen learned that it was not Ning Ziming's conscience who found out, but that he was worried about his own future.
Ning Ziming got the news that his political opponents already knew about his abandonment of his wife and son, so he took Ning Chen home first and made up a perfect story.
But the mistress of the Ning family, Chang Ruyue, and her three sons were worried that Ning Chen would divide the family property in the future, so they didn't want to see Ning Chen at all.
Ning Chen carefully pleases them every day, but all he gets is intensified bullying.
But no matter how he was bullied, Ning Chen remained silent because he didn't want to go wandering and begging anymore.
But what he doesn't know is that no matter how he compromises...the other party will never treat him as a family member, and they want his life.
Now that autumn has entered, Ning Chen is still wearing thin clothes, but he is infected with the wind and cold.
Not only did they not allow the doctor to treat Ning Chen, they also secretly poured cold water on Ning Chen's bedding.
As a result, Ning Chen became seriously ill and died without medical treatment.
Ning Chen sighed, he only had eight words for the former owner of this body... sad for his misfortune, angry for his inability to fight!
Just then, the door opened.
A lame old man wearing a rough dungaree came in.
Seeing Ning Chen sitting on the bed, the old man was startled at first, then his face was filled with surprise and he said: "Fourth Young Master, are you awake? That's great, that's great..."
This lame old man has been in Ning Mansion for a long time. When Ning Chen came, he was there... Others called him Lao Chai, and Ning Chen called him Uncle Chai.
title_en: Chapter 1: Feeling sorry for his misfortune and angry for not fighting Chapter 2: I gave him my life back
